change: jsoup #2423, source tags and callbacks in a cloned HTML parser
deployment: Complete pinned Maven production JAR with its optional re2j runtime dependency.
assumptions: A fresh JDK 21 JVM, an HTML parser with one source tag and one callback, and two parses on the very same clone. Tag names are lowercase in the HTML namespace.

questions.observer: Before lookup and on two parses, observe tag presence, voidness, span parent, tag text, total document text and callback count.
questions.basis: The registered source tag is void. The callback makes only a newly seen fresh tag void. A late source tag is registered after the clone exists. A void element cannot own the span or text.

questions.observer: Compare the same ordered lookups and two DOMs for a built-in void tag and an ordinary unknown tag.
questions.basis: The HTML br is void on both builds. A new tag without a matching customizer retains its text on both.
